items.product: East doll 24V ride-on dump truck, Caterpillar licensed, 2-seater, yellow
items.headline: The $210 off is fake. This is a $300 truck selling for $290.
reasons: The same seller lists this same truck on other Walmart pages at $299.99 to $309.99, with 'was' prices of $489.99 and $559.99. The crossed-out price changes from page to page.
The same Caterpillar truck under the TOKTOO name is $306.99, and Costway sells it at $320.99 against a $329.99 regular price. Real saving here: about $10 to $20.
Marketplace seller, not Walmart, and this listing has only 12 ratings. No price history could be found for it.
items.instead: If the Cat badge doesn't matter: Funride 4WD 24V 2-seater dump truck, 4x200W motors (double this one's power), $279.99 at Walmart with 723 reviews. If it has to be the Cat truck, $289.99 is a fair price. Just don't buy it for the discount.
